content: In what follows, we first provide some background about the MP framework (in sec. SECREF2), thoroughly describe and explain MPAD (sec. SECREF3), present our experimental framework (sec. SECREF4), report and interpret our results (sec. SECREF5), and provide a review of the relevant literature (sec. SECREF6).
